lines: Sarvesh Kumar Garg, Other Selling Shareholder, is due proceeds from selling 3,565,000 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of ₹117.65 crore are scheduled on or about Tuesday, November 3, 2026, not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
Retained shares of ₹64.75 crore (estimate, valued at offer price) carry a 6 months lock-in from Allotment, so more money comes later.
Gain is unknown: average cost of acquisition is not confirmed from the documents.
